description: Hindu panchang for a date and place, calculated by VedicDost's software: weekday (vaar), tithi with paksha, nakshatra, yoga, karana with end times, sunrise and sunset, Rahu kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Abhijit muhurat and the day choghadiya. Times are local to the place. Use for "aaj ka panchang", "Rahu kaal today", "which tithi is today", "shubh choghadiya".

language.description: User language: hi, en, mr, gu, bn, ta, te or kn (default en). Text and links come in this language.

place.description: City (default New Delhi), e.g. "Mumbai" or "Toronto, Canada"

name: get_panchang
title: Daily panchang (tithi, nakshatra, Rahu kaal)
